description: IAF executes precision airstrikes targeting eight Hezbollah Radwan Force military compounds in eastern Lebanon. Pre-war shaping operation to degrade Hezbollah C2 nodes ahead of broader regional escalation. Strikes penetrate reinforced subterranean bunkers.

IDF conducts airstrikes against suspected militant targets in Gaza killing five Palestinians. Strikes target multi-story building identified as clandestine weapons storage and manufacturing facility. Continuous pre-war low-intensity operations to prevent Hamas and PIJ reconstitution.

IAF expands target set to include Hezbollah financial assets and funding networks throughout Lebanon. Precision strikes against financial C2 nodes to induce logistical friction. Multi-domain attrition doctrine targeting economic center of gravity before main offensive.

Iranian missile strikes US Fifth Fleet service center in Manama Bahrain. 4 US soldiers killed — first US fatalities of war. All from 103rd Expeditionary Sustainment Command headquartered in Des Moines Iowa

Israeli forces hack IRIB satellite feed broadcasting Trump and Netanyahu speeches to Iranian people. Khatam al-Anbia Hospital Motahari Hospital and Valiasr Burn Hospital all in Tehran struck in vicinity — patients evacuated. WHO Director General Tedros calls hospital damage reports extremely worrying. IDF also targets ITV Channel 2 antenna near Gandhi Hospital disrupting state television. Iranian Red Crescent documents damage for legal proceedings.

IRGC Malek-Ashtar building in Tehran completely destroyed in joint US-Israel missile strike. Video footage by Iran International shows total destruction. Malek-Ashtar organization is Irans primary defense research and self-sufficiency organization responsible for weapons development including drones and missiles. Iranian parliament building also targeted. Leadership House compound the primary decapitation target also struck.

Central headquarters of Iranian police struck by Israeli warplanes. Police Chief Ahmad-Reza Radan confirms police buildings receiving regular direct hits. Main building of Tehran medical emergency services on Iranshahr Street also struck staff evacuated. IDF carries out afternoon bombing runs across Tehran. Residents describe heavier bombardment than day one.
During the evening an Iranian drone hits a tower in a residential area of Bahrain
Series of loud blasts recorded. RAF Akrotiri targeted by suspected drone strike. Five drones intercepted one hits airfield causing minor damage. Air raid sirens across Akrotiri and Dhekelia
Iran attacks commercial vessels in Strait of Hormuz. 150 freight ships including oil tankers stalled behind strait. IRGC warns will fire on ships passing through Hormuz

CENTCOM announces airstrikes begin against Iran. US deploys B-2 B-1 B-52 bombers Tomahawk missiles from destroyers HIMARS and first combat use of LUCAS drones. IAF deploys ~200 fighter jets in largest combat sortie in Israeli history. ~900 strikes in first 12 hours

IAF decapitation strikes kill Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei and family members. Defense Minister Aziz Nasirzadeh, IRGC commander Mohammad Pakpour, Ali Shamkhani, Salah Asadi, Mohammad Shirazi, Hossein Jabal Amelian also killed. ~40 officials killed in opening strikes

Explosions across Iranian cities in first wave. Natanz nuclear facility, missile sites, air defenses and command centers struck. Black Sparrow air-launched ballistic missiles fired from F-15s used for first time
US and Israel strike 500+ military targets in western and central Iran using over 1200 bombs in first 24 hours. HIMARS launchers used alongside Tomahawks and stealth bombers

Israel conducts coordinated cyberattacks. BadeSaba Calendar prayer app (5M downloads) hacked to broadcast defection messages. Iran's internet drops to 1-4% of normal levels causing 60+ hour near-total blackout

US Tomahawk missile strikes girls school in Minab adjacent to Sayyid al-Shuhada military complex. 180 killed mostly schoolchildren 95 wounded. Preliminary US investigation found outdated targeting data used. UN experts characterize as potential war crime
Sports hall in Lamerd bombed during girls practice session. At least 18 civilians killed

target: Port city and nuclear reactor vicinity
description: IRGC reports Bushehr port struck. Proximity to Bushehr Nuclear Power Plant prompts Rosatom to evacuate non-essential staff and suspend construction on new units

Iran launches Operation True Promise IV — retaliatory ballistic missiles toward Israel and multiple Gulf states. IRGC fires over 500 ballistic missiles and nearly 2000 drones in first week. Response far quicker than Twelve-Day War suggesting reorganized command structure
Two PMF fighters killed three injured in strikes on Jurf al-Sakhar south of Baghdad

target: Erbil International Airport and US Consulate
description: Iranian aerial attacks target infrastructure in Kurdistan Region hosting US military and civilian personnel including Erbil International Airport and US Consulate General. Most intercepted
Iranian drone strikes reported near Baghdad
Missiles confirmed in Israel. Direct hit in Tel Aviv kills one civilian woman injures 27 others. Strikes reported in Haifa and Tel Aviv
Strikes reported in Haifa. Jordan shoots down two Iranian ballistic missiles targeting its territory and handles 54 reports of falling debris

target: Kuwait International Airport and military bases
description: Missile and drone attacks on Kuwait. Explosions at Kuwait International Airport cause injuries. Kuwait foreign ministry summons Iranian ambassador
Ali Al Salem Air Base in Kuwait struck — also hosted Italian soldiers. IRGC confirms as one of four main US base targets
Iranian bomb hits vessel near Port Muscat

target: Largest US air base in Middle East
description: IRGC targets Al Udeid Air Base in Qatar. Qatar intercepts multiple waves of missile attacks reports no casualties or property damage
Residential building on outskirts of Doha hit by Iranian strike
Saudi Arabia confirms Iranian attacks on Riyadh and Eastern Province. Claims successful interceptions. Crown Prince MBS authorizes military force against further incursions
Abu Dhabi struck by Iranian ballistic missiles. One Asian national killed by interceptor debris falling on residential area. Fairmont The Palm hotel set on fire. Burj Al Arab damaged by fragments
Al Dhafra Air Base in UAE targeted by IRGC as one of four main US base targets. UAE claims to have successfully intercepted missiles
Fujairah struck by Iranian ballistic missiles as part of broader UAE attacks
Residential areas of Dubai near Burj Khalifa Dubai Marina and Dubai Palm hit. Fairmont The Palm set on fire 4 injured. Local sources confirm use of Shahed drones
Strikes reported in Minab, Hormozgan Province on Day 1. HRANA records significant casualties in this incident.

target: Bandar Jask — civilian and military targets
description: Strikes reported in Bandar Jask, Hormozgan Province on Day 1. HRANA records significant casualties in this incident.
Military facilities struck in Konarak, Sistan and Baluchestan. Military casualties recorded.
Military facilities struck in Chabahar, Sistan and Baluchestan. Military casualties recorded.
Military facilities struck in Shahin Dezh, West Azerbaijan. Military casualties recorded.
Mehrabad International Airport struck on Day 1 of the war. Confirmed in HRANA Day 1 report.
Iran's parliament building targeted by airstrikes on Day 1. Confirmed by Iranian state-linked media.

target: Fordow enrichment facility — deeply buried centrifuge halls
description: Fordow enrichment facility struck by GBU-57 Massive Ordnance Penetrator bunker-busters targeting deeply buried centrifuge halls. Confirmed in multiple sources covering Day 1 strikes.

location: Near Zayed International Airport, Abu Dhabi
target: Residential area near Zayed International Airport
description: Debris from intercepted Iranian missile falls on residential area near Zayed International Airport in Abu Dhabi. One Pakistani national civilian killed, seven others injured from shrapnel and blasts.

location: Palm Jumeirah / Burj Al Arab area, Dubai
target: Residential and commercial structures Palm Jumeirah and Burj Al Arab vicinity
description: Fallen Iranian missile debris causes damage to structures in Dubai including areas around Palm Jumeirah and Burj Al Arab hotel. Confirmed by multiple sources on Day 1.

location: Corniche / Al Dhafra / Bateen districts, Abu Dhabi
target: Civilian and mixed-use areas Corniche Al Dhafra and Bateen districts
description: Loud explosions shake Abu Dhabi's Corniche, Al Dhafra, and Bateen districts as Iranian ballistic missiles and debris impact across the capital on Day 1.
Drone strike on Abu Dhabi's Shah oil field causes fire on Day 1.
Iranian missiles again fired at Fifth Fleet headquarters in Bahrain

Second wave of US-Israel strikes on Tehran. B-2 bombers strike hardened ballistic missile facilities. Tehran Revolutionary Court bombed and destroyed. Explosions near Azadi Stadium Azadi Square and Milad Tower. At least 5 killed in Absardar region

Chief of Staff Abdolrahim Mousavi confirmed killed by Iranian state media. Former president Mahmoud Ahmadinejad initially reported killed though later reports unclear. Mohammad Baseri and Gholamreza Rezaian intelligence officials also killed

Ali Larijani announces Interim Leadership Council after Khamenei death. Iran's top security council confirms 40+ officials killed. Khamenei family members including daughter son-in-law grandchild also killed
Explosion near Erbil Airport after attack by Iraqi militia drones

location: Israel, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Jordan, Saudi Arabia
description: Iran launches retaliatory missile and drone strikes against Israel UAE Qatar Kuwait Bahrain Jordan and Saudi Arabia. IDF estimates ~170 ballistic missiles launched
Iranian missile breaches Israeli defenses and hits synagogue in Beit Shemesh killing 9 people leaving 11 missing injuring 51 others
Iranian ballistic missile hits area of Jerusalem towards end of day causing property damage wounding 6 people
Iranian attacks kill one person and injure 32 in Kuwait
Oil tanker Skylight targeted 5 nautical miles north of Khasab port. 4 injuries among Indian-Iranian crew
Marshall Islands-flagged tanker MKD VYOM damaged after being struck off Oman coast killing one crew member. Port of Duqm hit by two Iranian drones injuring one expatriate worker
Series of loud blasts recorded in Doha continuing for hours (~22:00 UTC)
Saudi Arabia claims to have shot down missiles fired at Prince Sultan Airbase and King Khalid International Airport (~15:30 UTC)
Riyadh again hit by direct Iranian strikes. Saudi oil refinery closed after being targeted by Iranian drones. Analyst states this marks a significant escalation
Debris from unidentified missile falls in Ain Tarma Syria causing damage and injuries

Amazon Web Services data center in UAE struck by Iranian drones causing sparks and fire. Complete power cut and shutdown. Temporary connectivity outage in availability zone. Multiple AWS data centers in UAE damaged leading to major web infrastructure outages across Middle East

target: Etihad Towers and Al-Salam Naval Base
description: Drone intercepted near Etihad Towers complex near Israeli embassy — debris damages towers injures woman and child. Two Iranian drones target warehouse at Al-Salam Naval Base causing fire

target: French naval base Camp de la Paix
description: French naval base Camp de la Paix in Abu Dhabi reportedly struck by Iranian missile or drone
RAF Typhoon shoots down Iranian drone bound for Qatari airspace. UK Defence Secretary Healey says Iran fired two missiles toward British Cyprus bases

target: General Staff of the Armed Forces building
description: Reports indicate the building of the General Staff of the Armed Forces in Tehran was struck on Day 2.
Army Joint Staff building in Tehran struck on Day 2.
Doushan Tappeh, also known as the 11th Tactical Air Base, struck. Initially confirmed in HRANA Day 2 report.
Fourth Tactical Air Base in Dezful struck on Day 2.
Attack on Mehran border regiment headquarters. Some reports mention killing of 21 individuals including career personnel and conscript soldiers.
IRGC missile bases near Kamyaran, Kurdistan targeted on Day 2.
Kamyaran Police Station No. 11 targeted on Day 2. Internal security target.
Basij base in Ta'avon Township, Kermanshah struck on Day 2. Fatalities reported.
IRGC headquarters in Ravansar struck. At least one death recorded, several injuries reported by HRANA.
Strike on IRGC installation in Kashan, Isfahan Province. Official report states 12 IRGC members killed.
Khatam al-Anbia Hospital in Tehran struck on Day 2. Confirmed in HRANA Day 2 report.
Motahari Hospital in Tehran struck on Day 2. Confirmed in HRANA Day 2 report.

target: Gandhi Hospital — evacuation of patients including children
description: Gandhi Hospital in Tehran struck. Multiple reports on Day 2 about damage and evacuation of patients including children.
Emergency base in Hamadan struck. Healthcare personnel injured.
Emergency base in Sarab struck. Healthcare personnel injured.
National wrestling teams training camp struck on Day 2.
Handball Federation facilities struck on Day 2.
Educational center in Urmia struck. Two individuals injured.

target: Multiple F-14 Tomcat fighter jets at airbases across Iran
description: USAF strikes hit military aircraft and drone launchers including multiple F-14 Tomcat fighter jets at airbases across Iran on Day 2. Confirmed in Wikipedia timeline of the 2026 Iran war.

target: Nabi Chit — Hezbollah infrastructure and personnel
description: IDF strikes Nabi Chit in eastern Lebanon. Lebanese Health Ministry confirms over 41 people killed and 40 more injured. Deaths include at least three Lebanese Armed Forces soldiers and one General Security Directorate member. IDF also conducts operation in area reportedly related to search for Ron Arad.

target: Foreign vessel undergoing maintenance in Salman Industrial City
description: Debris from intercepted Iranian missile falls onto a foreign vessel undergoing maintenance in Salman Industrial City, Bahrain. One Asian worker killed. Confirmed by Bahrain Ministry of Interior.
Dubai International Airport hit by debris from a fallen Iranian missile on Day 2. Airport operations affected. Third incident at the airport since Iran began striking UAE.
Drone strike on a building in Umm Al Quwain, UAE causes fire on Day 2.

IDF destroys IRIB Islamic Republic of Iran Broadcasting headquarters complex in Tehran. IAF fighter jets drop dozens of bombs completely destroying the building. IDF says Iranian regime used communications center to advance IRGC military activities under civilian cover. IRIB confirms departments bombed. State television programs disrupted for several minutes. Marks destruction of Irans main state media apparatus.
Iranian strike targets Mina Salman port in Bahrain causing fire. Debris from intercepted missile kills one worker on foreign ship injures two

RAF Akrotiri targeted again by drone strike around 00:20 UTC setting off air raid sirens. Five drones intercepted one hits airfield causing minor damage. UK MoD confirms base responded. Drones launched before UK permitted US to use bases

Iranian strikes on shipping continue. US-flagged tanker Stena Imperative hit by projectiles off Bahrain fire extinguished. IRGC claims drone strike on Honduras-flagged tanker Athe Nova in Strait of Hormuz

target: Government and military targets — night strikes
description: IDF strikes dozens of command sites at night in Tehran including ten Ministry of Intelligence sites and one Quds Force site. Khatam-al-Anbia and Gandhi hospitals hit verified by BBC. IDF levels General Staff of Internal Security forces and Thar-Allah HQ

Satellite images confirm Natanz nuclear facility sustained damage. IAEA confirms entrance buildings damaged but no radiological consequence expected. Natanz fuel enrichment plant itself not additionally damaged

PJAK Kurdish armed groups begin military offensive into Iranian territory according to Coalition of Political Forces of Iranian Kurdistan. Thousands of troops cross border. American and Israeli officials reportedly confirm. PJAK official later denies
Two drones target US Victory Base near Baghdad International Airport one reportedly strikes base. Guardians of the Blood Brigade claims responsibility in retaliation for Khamenei assassination
Islamic Resistance in Iraq claims responsibility for over 23 drone strikes on US assets in Erbil
Hezbollah rockets and missiles hit open areas of northern Israel. IDF intercepts one rocket others hit open areas
Iranian missile hits neighborhood in Beersheba injuring 19 people
Kuwaiti F/A-18 pilot shoots down three US F-15E fighters in friendly fire incident. Six crew members survive. First major friendly fire incident of war
US Embassy in Kuwait struck and closed indefinitely. No casualties reported. Smoke rises from embassy

target: Missile defense site south of Haifa
description: Hezbollah launches projectiles into northern Israel in early hours — first attacks since 2024 ceasefire. Sets off sirens across Haifa and Upper Galilee. IDF declares this an official declaration of war by Hezbollah. Hezbollah says retaliation for killing of Khamenei

In response to Hezbollah war declaration IDF strikes Beirut and Beqaa Valley. IDF strikes 70+ targets in Dahieh and southern Lebanon. IDF kills Hezbollah intelligence HQ head Hussein Makled. Evacuation orders issued in 50 communities
IDF strikes southern Lebanon towns including Haris Nabatieh al-Fawqa and Mayfadoun. IDF kills Abu Hamza Rami PIJ commander in Lebanon in Beirut overnight
IDF strikes southern Lebanon. Lebanon bans military activities by Hezbollah after attacks. Lebanese government calls for Hezbollah to hand over weapons
Qatar shoots down two Iranian Su-24 bombers — first nation to shoot down manned Iranian aircraft in the conflict
Iranian drones strike Qatar LNG facilities halting production. Missiles and drones launched at Al Udeid Air Base and industrial facilities. QatarEnergy later declares force majeure on gas exports
Aramco Ras Tanura oil refining facility damaged causing contained fire. Saudi officials state it was debris from intercepted Iranian missile. Iran denies targeting facility
UAE claims to have downed 148 Iranian drones 9 ballistic missiles and half a dozen cruise missiles. Witnesses see smoke over Dubai and dark plumes from Port of Jebel Ali

target: Law Enforcement Command Headquarters of Kurdistan
description: Law Enforcement Command Headquarters of Kurdistan Province struck in Sanandaj.
Kurdistan Border Guard Command Center in Sanandaj struck.

target: 8th Tactical Air Base — Islamic Republic of Iran Air Force
description: 8th Tactical Air Base of the Islamic Republic of Iran Air Force in Isfahan targeted.
Army Self-Sufficiency Jihad Base in Tehran targeted.
Mosque in Mehrshahr, Karaj struck. Protected site under international humanitarian law.
Governor's office in Rey struck on Day 3.
Shahid Bahonar Pier in Bandar Abbas struck on Day 3.

target: Residential complex on Sepahbod Qarani Street
description: Residential complex on Sepahbod Qarani Street in Tehran struck. Protected civilian structure.

target: Iranshahr Street Emergency building and adjacent buildings
description: Airstrike damaged the Iranshahr Street Emergency building and several adjacent buildings in Tehran.
Residential building on Shariati Street in Tehran struck. One worker killed in a workshop in the same area.
Sirens activated all over Bahrain pre-dawn. Government calls for residents to stay safe. Bahrain reports 74 successfully intercepted missiles and 92 drones since 28 February

Projectile destroys structure 350 meters from Bushehr Nuclear Power Plant reactor. Confirmed by Airbus satellite imagery via Institute for Science and International Security. Iran reports incident to IAEA. No reactor damage detected. Proximity causes severe international alarm — IAEA monitors closely. Rosatom evacuates non-essential staff suspends new unit construction. Strikes also reportedly destroy underground nuclear weapons facility called Min Zadai beneath SNSC headquarters per Israeli officials.

Israel bombs Irans Assembly of Experts building while its 84 members are in preliminary meeting to elect new supreme leader following Khamenei death. Represents direct targeting of constitutional successor-selection process. Explosion reported near Russian Consulate in Isfahan causing damage. Golestan Palace UNESCO World Heritage Site also damaged in collateral blast prompting UNESCO to condemn attack on protected heritage site.

US-Israeli strikes destroy Supreme National Security Council headquarters Expediency Discernment Council building and alleged underground nuclear facility Min Zadai. Also hit: Assembly of Experts building old imperial Senate Mirdamad Street. Israel reports destroying 300 Iranian missile launchers since war began

Isfahan and Kermanshah and Shiraz bombed along with other Iranian cities. IRIB Tehran HQ bombed second day in row. Golestan Palace UNESCO World Heritage Site hit by debris from airstrike causing damage to Brilliant Hall and Marble Throne
Shiraz and Fars province struck in continued wave of US-Israeli strikes

Bushehr Airport struck in precision strike — Iran Air Airbus A319 (EP-IEP) on tarmac totally destroyed. Significant structural damage to terminal. Proximity to nuclear plant prompts Rosatom to evacuate staff

US destroys 17 Iranian ships including most operational Iranian submarine (IRIS Fateh — first submarine sunk in conflict since Falklands War). US sinks missile corvette IRIS Shahid Soleimani. Major degradation of Iranian naval capabilities in Gulf of Oman
Iran launches massive drone strikes against Erbil Iraq. Islamic Resistance in Iraq claims responsibility for explosions in Erbil
Israeli Police report one person injured after Iranian shrapnel falls in Tel Aviv. Bnei Brak and Rosh HaAyin see Iranian strikes causing 7 injuries total
IDF kills Daoud Alizadeh commander of IRGC Quds Force Lebanon branch in Tehran. Israel Defense Minister authorizes ground invasion of Lebanon to seize strategic positions
IDF strikes kill senior IRGC commander. IDF also kills one IRGC commander separately
Israeli ground forces begin moving into southern Lebanon. First land-based clashes of Lebanon war. IDF 91st Division establishes security layer against Hezbollah
IDF detains dozen Hezbollah members after rocket strike. Hezbollah launches drones and missiles at Israeli bases. WHO reports 3 paramedics killed 6 injured in southern Lebanon
Iranian attack on Hamad International Airport stopped by Qatari forces. Amazon Web Services targeted across Gulf states causing significant damages in UAE and Bahrain facilities
US Embassy in Riyadh struck by two Iranian drones causing fire and prompting its closure. CIA headquarters in Riyadh also hit. Kingdom downs 9 drones entering Saudi airspace
UAE detects numerous missiles heading from Iran at ~3:30am local time (23:30 GMT). Multiple missile and drone interceptions
US Consulate in Al Seef Dubai struck by multiple drones causing fire. Witnesses see smoke over Port of Jebel Ali
Iranian attack on UAE Fujairah Oil Industry Zone causes debris to fall and start fire
Allah Akbar Garrison in Tehran struck on Day 4.

target: Military headquarters affiliated with the Mohammad Rasoul Allah Corps
description: Military headquarters affiliated with the Mohammad Rasoul Allah Corps in Kermanshah struck.
Army 328th Infantry Brigade garrison in Marivan struck on Day 4.
Shahid Yazdani Garrison in Najafabad struck on Day 4.
Imam Hossein University in Tehran struck on Day 4.
Shohada Hospital in Sarpol-e Zahab struck. Protected medical facility under international humanitarian law.
Field hospital in Salas-e Babajani struck. Protected medical facility under international humanitarian law.
Criminal Investigation Department in Marivan struck on Day 4.
Nuclear facilities in Natanz struck on Day 4. Confirmed in HRANA Day 4 report.
Dezful Radio building in Dezful struck on Day 4.

target: US warplanes — several crash in Kuwait
description: Kuwait Defence Ministry reports several US warplanes crashed in the country. All crew survived. Confirmed by Kuwait Defence Ministry on Day 4.

target: Shah oil field Abu Dhabi — second strike
description: Second drone strike targeting Abu Dhabi Shah oil field causing fire on Day 4.
Bahrain attacked by Iranian missiles (13:45 UTC)

Iranian strike hits and apparently destroys AN/TPY-2 THAAD radar system at Muwaffaq Salti Air Base Jordan. Satellite imagery by CNN and Bloomberg confirms destruction. US official later confirms. Radar over 500 miles from Iran demonstrates long-range precision targeting of US missile defense architecture. THAAD battery radar provides early warning for ballistic missile interception across region. Estimated value $300 million.

Iranian strikes hit THAAD radar battery sites at Al Ruwais and Sader UAE. Satellite imagery shows dark markings on three buildings including pull-through vehicle sheds housing radar systems. Represents systematic targeting of US missile defense infrastructure across Gulf. Smoke also seen near Prince Sultan Air Base Saudi Arabia near THAAD radar position. Multiple US radar systems struck in opening days degrading missile interception capability.
Iranian landing ship IRIS Lavan with 183 sailors seeks refuge and is interned at Kochi India late evening following attack on IRIS Dena

USS Charlotte (submarine) sinks Iranian frigate IRIS Dena ~40 nautical miles south of Galle Sri Lanka. Ship returning from International Fleet Review 2026 in Visakhapatnam India and carried no ammunition per exercise rules. 87 killed 32 rescued by Sri Lanka Navy. First ship sunk by submarine in combat since Falklands War
US-Israeli airstrike sinks Iranian Soleimani-class corvette in port of Bandar Abbas (13:15 UTC). Second Iranian warship sunk that day

target: Iranian Yak-130 — first F-35 air kill
description: IDF F-35I Adir shoots down Russian-made Iranian Yak-130 fighter jet over Tehran. First time in history stealth fighter shoots down manned aircraft in air-to-air combat. First Israeli air-to-air kill since 1985

target: Major military outpost — all Iranian security branches (16:15 UTC)
description: Israel announces completion of major large-scale airstrikes on military outpost housing soldiers from all branches of Iran's security apparatus (16:15 UTC). Basij HQ hit. Missile launch pads defense systems supply directorate struck
Iranian drones attack Sulaymaniyah in Iraqi Kurdistan
Drone downed near Baghdad International Airport. Guardians of Blood Brigade attacks US Victory Base. PMF factions conduct multiple drone strikes against US infrastructure
IRGC Ground Forces attack Kuwait with large number of drones. 11-year-old girl killed after being hit by shrapnel
Syrian forces block Syrian-Lebanese border claiming to stop Hezbollah from crossing and smuggling weapons (10:00 UTC)
Multiple rockets missiles and drones launched toward Israel from Lebanon and Iran simultaneously (11:55-12:35 UTC). First major combined Hezbollah-Iran strike

Israel launches retaliatory airstrikes at Hezbollah targets in southern Lebanon. Lebanon's Islamic Group HQ destroyed. Hezbollah clashes with Israeli forces in Khiam. Hezbollah claims hitting Israeli tank in Houla — Israel confirms two soldiers injured by anti-tank fire

Israeli ground forces move deeper into Lebanon. First land-based clashes of war. IDF 91st Division advances beyond five existing positions. Hezbollah Puma APC damaged by rocket then Caterpillar D9 bulldozer hit assisting it killing two soldiers
QatarEnergy declares force majeure on gas exports and shuts down gas liquefaction. Al Udeid Air Base hit with no casualties per Qatari MoD
Aramco Ras Tanura oil refining facility again hit by Iranian projectile

NATO air defenses shoot down Iranian ballistic missile over Hatay Province landing in Dörtyol. SM-3 interceptor launched from USS Oscar Austin. Turkey asserts right to self-defense. Iran claims technical anomaly. NATO Article 4 consultations begin. First Iranian missile to land on NATO territory
IRGC Aerospace Force attacks Port of Fujairah with ballistic missile
Alborz Industrial Town in Qazvin struck on Day 5.
Industrial town in Urmia struck on Day 5.
IRGC logistics warehouse in Vardavard struck on Day 5.
Ashura Garrison in Najafabad struck on Day 5.
Basij base in Afsariyeh district of Tehran struck on Day 5.
Ba'athat Hospital in Tehran struck. Protected medical facility under international humanitarian law.
Esmat Girls High School in Urmia struck. Educational facility — protected under international humanitarian law.
Blood Transfusion Organization building in Urmia struck on Day 5.
Sarallah Hosseiniyeh in Shiraz struck. Protected under international humanitarian law.
Surgical center in Sohrevardi district of Tehran struck. Protected medical facility under international humanitarian law.

Two Iranian drones strike Azerbaijan's Nakhchivan exclave. One hits terminal of Nakhchivan International Airport another lands near school in Shakarabad village. Two civilians injured. Azerbaijan summons Iranian ambassador withdraws diplomats and promises military response. First Iranian attack on Azerbaijan. IRGC Telegram channel claims responsibility
Iran targets US oil tanker in Persian Gulf according to The Guardian. IRGC attacks Malta-flagged oil tanker Prima with drone after vessel ignores warnings about Strait of Hormuz closure
Greek F-16 fighters down multiple Iranian Shahed drones near Cyprus. Larnaca International Airport temporarily closed. Italy Netherlands and Spain confirm sending warships to defend Cyprus

Iran's largest sports complex — 12000-seat Azadi Stadium arena — destroyed by US-Israeli strike. Two Basij student leaders killed in Israeli airstrikes. Israel launches widespread wave of attacks on Tehran in response to Iranian missile fire

target: Early morning missile barrages on Israel
description: Iran launches missiles at Israel in early hours setting off air-raid alerts in Tel Aviv area. No immediate casualties reported
Multiple missile salvos target Israeli cities. Suspected debris from intercepted Iranian missile lands in Petah Tikva causing fire
IDF kills Hamas official Wassim Attallah al-Ali in Beddawi Lebanon
Iranian attacks on shipping near Khasab Oman continue
Saudi Arabia intercepts over three cruise missiles in early hours outside city of Al-Kharj
NATO integrated air defense systems intercept Iranian missile entering Turkish airspace over Hatay. Turkey deploys F-16s and air defense to Northern Cyprus
Ministry of Intelligence office in Sardasht struck on Day 6.
IRGC Imam Ali garrison in Sanandaj struck on Day 6.
Paper factory in Malayer struck on Day 6.
Chazabeh border terminal in Dasht-e Azadegan struck on Day 6.
Jannat Abad Police Station No. 138 in Tehran struck on Day 6.
Yas Nabi Girls Elementary School in Tehran struck. Educational facility — protected under international humanitarian law.
12000-seat Azadi Stadium in Tehran struck on Day 6. Confirmed in HRANA Day 6 report.
Basat Stadium in Tehran struck on Day 6.
District 18 Municipality building in Tehran struck on Day 6.

Reuters reports US military has sunk over 30 Iranian ships since war began. CENTCOM confirms 19 ships 1 submarine and nearly 2000 military targets cumulatively destroyed. Iran claims AN/FPS-132 radar in Qatar and AN/TPS-59 radar in Bahrain also destroyed. Systematic US campaign eliminates Iranian blue-water naval capability. IRGC retains fast-boat and mine threat but organized fleet operations effectively ended.
Bahrain targeted — hotel and two residential buildings hit by Iranian attacks

Heavy US-Israel airstrikes on Tehran Kermanshah Salmas Maku and Saqqez in western Iran. IRGC intelligence site in Lorestan hit. Bank Sepah branch in Tehran struck. IRGC warns future retaliation against US or Israeli banks
US and Israeli airstrikes hit IRGC intelligence site in Lorestan province

Late on Friday drones strike Iraqi airports and oil facilities. Basra compound housing Halliburton and KBR workers hit and set on fire. Compounds and oil refineries of Halliburton in Basra repeatedly targeted
Iran attacks Kuwait with drones and missiles as part of new wider Gulf offensive

Hezbollah targets Inkhil Syria following Syrian president's support for disarming Hezbollah. Shells from Lebanon land in Serghaya near Damascus. Syrian army confirms and warns against attacks on its territory
Three Ghanaian UNIFIL peacekeepers hit by missile and wounded in Southern Lebanon
IDF continues ground operations in southern Lebanon expanding buffer zone
Sri Lanka Navy takes charge of Iranian tanker IRIS Bushehr and its 208 crew. Vessel moved to Trincomalee area. First warship interned in neutral country since World War II
Qatar intercepts 13 Iranian missiles. Iran strikes Qatar as part of wider Gulf offensive
Iran launches new wider Gulf offensive. Saudi Arabia intercepts 3 missiles at Prince Sultan Air Base
Mehrabad Airport compound struck again on Day 7.
Police Station No. 11 in Tehran struck on Day 7.
IRGC Vali-e Asr Barracks in Tehran struck on Day 7.
Intelligence building in Ilam struck on Day 7.

target: Ministry of Intelligence office Sarpol-e Zahab
description: Ministry of Intelligence office building in Sarpol-e Zahab struck on Day 7.
Mahabad Red Crescent humanitarian facility struck on Day 7. Protected humanitarian organization under international humanitarian law.

target: Medical emergency team operational base Shiraz
description: Medical emergency team operational base in Shiraz struck following reported attack on Day 7.
Fars Governorate building in Shiraz struck on Day 7.
National Iranian Oil Company facility in Miandoab struck on Day 7.

Tehran Mehrabad International Airport struck in early hours. IDF destroys 16 Quds Force aircraft. Israeli military confirms fuel storage facilities in Tehran targeted. Strikes hit oil depots near Tehran causing river of fire along streets and cloud of toxic black smoke

target: Fuel storage energy complexes Tehran Karaj
description: Israel carries out first targeted energy strikes — fuel storage sites in Tehran and neighboring Karaj struck. IDF confirms striking fuel storage and energy complexes used by Iranian Armed Forces. Marks significant escalation from military targets to energy infrastructure. US had opposed Israeli targeting of Iranian oil sites. First step in escalation ladder culminating in South Pars strike eleven days later.
US and Israeli forces strike infrastructure targets in Isfahan as part of continued campaign
Halliburton and KBR facilities in Basra hit again by Iranian strikes. IRGC attacks Malta-flagged tanker Prima with drone

Single Iranian drone strike on US base at Port Shuaiba kills 6 US service members — largest single-incident US death toll of war. 4 others seriously injured. All from 103rd Expeditionary Sustainment Command

Israel continues strikes in southern Lebanon. IDF strikes Hezbollah targets. Pezeshkian tells reporters Iran will stop striking neighbors unless attack originates from there — IRGC ignores and continues attacks
Iran continues missile strikes on Saudi Arabia. Kuwait Petroleum Corporation declares force majeure cutting oil output
Iranian drones attack Fujairah port and industrial area

Dubai International Airport attacked by Iranian drones later in day despite Pezeshkian ceasefire statement. Two drones fall near airport wounding four people. Airport temporarily halted then resumed limited operations
Municipality of District 16 in Tehran struck on Day 8.

target: Shahid Boroujerdi Logistics and Support Garrison
description: Shahid Boroujerdi Logistics and Support Garrison in Tehran struck on Day 8.

description: Khatam al-Anbia Joint Air Defense Headquarters in Ahvaz struck on Day 8.

Qeshm Island desalination plant struck on Day 8. Critical civilian water infrastructure.

Iran specifically warns UAE and Bahrain — the two Arab countries offering to join Hormuz campaign — that they will be the first to lose in this battle. UAE Bahrain UK France Germany issue joint statement condemning Iranian attacks on commercial vessels and calling for halt to mine-laying drone and missile attacks in Gulf.

Second Iranian drone strike wave hits Mina al-Ahmadi refinery Kuwait causing additional fires. Iran continues systematic energy infrastructure campaign. US accelerates deployment of 11th Marine Expeditionary Unit 2200 Marines from San Diego aboard USS Boxer ahead of schedule. 11th MEU expected to deploy with at least two additional ships. Brent crude at $112 per barrel. Trump hints at winding down military operations telling reporters he is considering it.

IDF Northern Command establishes Litani Security Line — heavily fortified buffer zone from Blue Line to Litani River. Concrete blast walls autonomous sensor arrays and hardened FOBs constructed. De facto tactical annexation displacing local civilian population southward.

Remaining IRGC Navy elements besieged at Bandar Abbas naval complex formally surrender to Artesh naval forces. Relinquished control of anti-ship cruise missile batteries. IRGCN extinguished as functional combat entity. Strait of Hormuz definitively secured from rogue naval elements. 14 IRGC loyalists killed in final standoff.

IDF border surveillance detects and intercepts lone insurgent attempting to breach Litani Security Line using rudimentary explosives. Neutralized by automated remote-controlled weapon station before breaching primary perimeter. Signals transition from state-on-state warfare to indefinite low-intensity counter-insurgency.

IDF begins wave of strikes targeting remaining command nodes not previously heavily targeted. US simultaneously waives Iran oil sanctions for 30 days to ease energy crisis — expected to release 140 billion barrels to global markets. Brent crude Brent $112 per barrel.
